children.title: SMB / SME
lines: Small and Medium-sized Businesses (EN) / Kleine und mittlere Unternehmen - KMU (DE); firms up to ~500 employees, usually without a dedicated security team. The target market for "conveyor-belt" security products.

children.title: MSP
lines: Managed Services Provider - runs IT (and often security) for SMBs.

children.title: MSSP
lines: Managed Security Services Provider - the security-specialized MSP; runs 24/7 detection/response for many clients.

children.title: SaaS
lines: Software as a Service - cloud software delivered over the internet; SOC 2 reports are usually a purchasing prerequisite for SaaS buyers.

children.title: Enterprise
lines: Large organizations: multi-account/multi-cloud governance, central policies, compliance programs - a different sales motion than SMB.

children.title: KMU
lines: German abbreviation for SMB (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen).
